correctness.rationale: For a chord with minor arc W/2, crossing probability is W-W^2/2; W is iid U[0,1]. The centered Hoeffding projection g(W)=W-W^2/2-1/3 has variance 1/45; the canonical degenerate residual kernel has variance 8/45 and disjoint/shared-index terms are uncorrelated, giving exact finite variances and covariance -n(n-1)t(1-t)(2-t)/6. Differentiating t(1-t)(2-t)^2 yields unique interior maximizer (7-sqrt17)/8. Empirical Donsker for the W_i and exact integration-by-parts identity produce the joint bridge limit; scaled residual variance O(n^-1) vanishes. Independently verified symbolic g integrals/threshold polynomial, and the known exact chord-count variance matches Flajolet–Noy Theorem 3. The result is not a full nonlinear conditional expectation.
residual_risks: Donsker and the continuous-mapping theorem are used as standard results rather than reproved; finite matching checks do not prove functional weak convergence.
